messages:
Mia: Quick sync — need to lock initiative alpha scope and confirm cross-team deps (runtime / infra / security). Can folks chime on blockers and rough ETA? :spiral_calendar:
Raj: On runtime side we need model-variant routing + prewarm slots defined. If product pins seq_len 2k we need different kernels. ETA: 2 weeks for perf baseline.
Elaine: Infra - capacity slots and reserved burst need #s. If we allocate 2x burst for alpha that impacts other pilots. Need customer commitments for dedicated capacity.
Sam: Security flagged two items: KMS/HSM for private tenants and audit retention for eval logs. Both need design review. HSM path adds ~3 weeks if we require hardware-backed keys.
Jordan: Platform: rollout automation and canary policy depend on runtime exposing feature-flag and health endpoints. Small change but needs testing in staging.
Mia: Good context. Here are proposed launch criteria (draft): 1) Perf within 20% of baseline for 95th p50/p95 2) Canary + auto-fallback to lighter model 3) KMS in place for private tenants 4) Capacity pin + documented cost estimate
Raj: +1. For the canary -> fallback we should add a routing policy sample:
```
routing:
  policy: latency_priority
  fallback: model-quant-8bit
  canary_window: 5m
  p95_threshold_ms: 220
```
Elaine: For capacity math, if alpha target 200 QPS with avg seq 800 and batch 8, rough GPU hours = 200 * seq_factor / efficiency — can do calc in spreadsheet. I can share numbers after capacity model run.
Sam: Note: if we use HSM, onboarding requires security signoff + customer legal ack. Suggest two tracks: "compliant" (HSM + audit) and "standard" (KMS + tightened logs). Product must pick per-customer route.
Mia: OK. Product proposal: go with "standard" for early pilot to shorten time-to-pilot; mark HSM as enterprise requirement for GA for regulated customers. Thoughts?
Raj: That reduces timeline. With standard we can hit perf baseline in 2 weeks. HSM path = +3 weeks.
Elaine: Agree. Also need to schedule infra change window for reserve pool. Prefer next Tuesday maintenance window.
Jordan: I'll add tests for health endpoints and automated rollback in staging. Rough ETA 5 days after runtime branch merges.
Mia: Action items:
- Raj: perf baseline + routing policy implementation (owner: Raj) — due in 2w
- Elaine: capacity model + reserve-slot request (owner: Elaine) — due in 4d
- Sam: security review for "standard" track and HSM checklist (owner: Sam) — due in 5d
- Jordan: canary automation + rollback tests (owner: Jordan) — due in 7d
- Mia: finalize product acceptance criteria and customer communication (owner: Mia) — due in 3d
Please ping if any dependency mismatches. If no objections, I'll lock scope tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window request created: ticket INFRA-8921, tentative window 2026-04-14 02:00 UTC.
Mia: Thanks — linking ticket in roadmap doc. We'll keep this thread for final signoff.
